Used for the optional all-sky/rig safety monitor, and to use an iPhone or other Continuity Camera/USB webcam as a live capture source (e.g. eyepiece afocal photography) — the ZWO ASI SDK path talks to ASI cameras directly over USB and doesn't need this permission.
Used to tag a project or session with your observing location — recorded once per request, not tracked continuously, and only when you tap "Use Current Location."
Used only when you tap "Save to Photos" on an image — adds that one file to your library, never reads or modifies your existing photos.
